steps: Become a Proesis donor yourself first
Refer friends/family via the ProesisPlus app
Each referred new donor completes two donations within 6 months
Collect $50 per referral on your prepaid Visa debit card
timing: $50 paid after the referred donor completes two donations within their first six months; paid to your prepaid Visa debit card
who_pays: Proesis Bio pays the $50 referral bonus onto YOUR reloadable prepaid Visa debit card (Paysign) after the referred donor completes their second donation.
who_qualifies: You must already be a current Proesis donor — non-donors can't earn it. Your referred friend must be brand new to Proesis AND complete two donations within 6 months of their first donation. Refer through the ProesisPlus app so it's tracked.
work_available: Live as posted on proesisbio.com/compensation as of 2026-09-23. No stated cap on the number of referrals — but it only works at Proesis centers (TX, NC, ID), so your friends need to be near one.
what_gets_accepted: A referral only pays after the friend completes TWO donations within their first 6 months — one-and-done friends earn you nothing. The six-month clock starts at their first donation.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Nearly zero of your own time — about 5-15 minutes to refer someone in the app. But your pay depends entirely on someone else following through with two needle donations, which is the real risk.
when_cash_arrives: $50 per qualifying referral, paid to your prepaid Visa debit card after the referred donor's second donation.
reject_reason: offline/in-person — catalog is online-only per owner 2026-09-23
